boundaries.name: hashOpaque
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon is an opaque callback; no collision resistance or injectivity is assumed.

boundaries.name: consumerDistinctnessObligation
boundaries.obligation: The chain binds ordered pairs only; pubkey distinctness, all-members-present and pk-in-member-set are consumer obligations.

boundaries.name: nativeCircuitAgreement
boundaries.obligation: Bit-for-bit agreement between the native reference and the in-circuit gadget is asserted by the source, not proved here.
